image_description: Two translucent teal plastic disposable lighters standing upright against a white background with faint, blurry text artifacts. The lighter on the left shows a side profile with a visible metal wind guard and spark wheel mechanism. The lighter on the right is angled slightly differently, showing the front/top assembly. Both have clear plastic bodies revealing internal components.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects are clearly standard disposable lighter proportions, consistent with handheld size.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both lighters have the characteristic rectangular prism body shape of disposable butane lighters with fixed tops.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: These are fixed-top disposable lighters; the spark wheel mechanism is correctly identified and present.

Contextually and structurally, these are clearly portable lighters.

artifact_observations.location: Background, primarily right side and bottom left
artifact_observations.reasoning: Faint, nonsensical letter-like shapes and blobs float in the white background, typical of AI training data leakage or diffusion artifacts attempting to render text/logos that aren't there.

The refraction and internal details of the translucent plastic look slightly 'smudged' or painterly rather than optically precise. The internal tubes don't align perfectly with expected physical geometry.

artifact_observations.location: Top metal assembly of the right lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal hood/wind guard on the right lighter appears slightly fused into the plastic body without a clean seam, and the geometry of the spark wheel area is less defined than the left lighter.

selected_experts.reason: Confirm specific type (disposable butane lighter) and rule out misclassification as similar cylindrical objects.
Audit the boundary between the translucent plastic and the white background for edge bleeding, and check internal component connectivity.
Verify spatial relationship between the two lighters and ensure the background artifacts don't indicate depth map failures.
Analyze the gibberish shapes in the background to confirm they are failed text generations rather than intentional design elements.
Holistic assessment of material rendering quality (plastic translucency) and lighting consistency.

focus_areas: Translucency and refraction accuracy of plastic bodies
Mechanical precision of the metal top assembly (spark wheel, nozzle)
Background noise and potential text artifacts
Edge sharpness between subject and background
